discovery_descriptions.replacement: Discovery revalidates the tracked checkout/.git aliases, gitdir and commondir pointer paths/targets, and parsed alternate-entry paths. At 7f1888960 it neither records nor revalidates the initial <common>/objects target. A stable link into an allocated tree can lose a live job’s object storage; retargeting that link during discovery can also evade incomplete discovery when its alternates file stays absent or keeps the same inode and contents (R4-F1). These failures require neither a swap-back nor a metadata-preserving write. The documented swap-back, timestamp and later-dependency bounds remain additional limits of the observations.

Already-quarantined and archived old journals can reach final_check and archive publication without that field; commit computes its fallback outside the transaction.
